name: fireapproved-data
title: FireApproved.com structured data
description: CC BY 4.0 mirrors of the structured data published by FireApproved.com, a citation directory for wildfire-resistant construction and plants.

resources.name: plants-evidence-plants-evidence-csv
resources.title: Plant flammability evidence directory
resources.description: 3801 plants carrying 26878 cited flammability evidence rows, plus the 112-source registry they are attributed to. Each row keeps the source's own wording of its finding, the edition, and the date the document was read. Classifications are computed from the evidence by a published rule, so they can be reproduced.

resources.name: osfm-bml-censuses-osfm-bml-censuses-csv
resources.title: CAL FIRE OSFM Building Materials Listing — WUI category censuses
resources.description: 276 listed wildland-urban-interface building products across 16 OSFM category codes, from a frozen snapshot. Every listing in a covered category is present. Each row keeps the listing ID, the product name as the listing records it, the BML application number, and the expiry.
